name: Ring with a Scarab Bezel
description: Palette extracted from the public-domain work “Ring with a Scarab Bezel” by Ancient Egyptian (Second Intermediate Period, Dynasty 15 (about 1650–1550 BCE)), Art Institute of Chicago artwork 594. Adapted for high-contrast GameCore 5.1 UI.
changelog: 1.0.0 — source-backed palette; ≥7:1 body text and ≥4.5:1 controls.
